title: Research Outpost Lab
summary: One small, reusable single-storey research lab that can also stand in a city block: front entrance, flank breach panel, case room, straight stair to an accessible roof, and a smash-through roof panel. Enterable, breakable in selected places, no invisible solid box across any opening.

provenance.author: codex/enterable-building-pilot
provenance.note: Every vertex and collider is generated from this recipe by tools/building-delivery/build-lab.mjs. There is NO external, downloaded, licensed or paid asset input. The only build inputs are this recipe and the committed generator sources; a clean checkout rebuilds byte-identical outputs with Node alone.

license.text: Original procedural geometry and data. Dedicated to the public domain (CC0-1.0); usable without attribution or credential.

generator.dependencies: none (pure Node stdlib; a hand-written GLB writer, no three.js, no gltf-transform)

units.gameConversion: 1:1 — the recipe is authored directly in PowerWorld world units, so no scale is applied at import. The metre figure is documentation only.
units.derivation: Measured from the runtime, not guessed: src/engine/citytiles.js door metric `DH = 11.2 * M` is commented 'a 2.1m doorway', so 2.1 m / 11.2 u = 0.1875 m/u; the same file builds a 9.6u human = 1.8 m. 1 m = 5.3333 u.

axes.note: Building origin (0,0,0) is the ground-centre of the footprint, floor plane at y=0. The entrance faces +Z; the breach panel is on the +X flank. The runtime places the building by an (x,z) world centre and a yaw; these local axes rotate with that yaw.

fitting.note: Native fitting reference, measured from runtime source constants (the handoff's instruction: use native Sarge scale, do not guess a metre conversion). Cited so a reviewer can re-check.
fitting.soldierHeroHeightSource: src/engine/citytiles.js metric comment '9.6u human = 1.8m'; soldiers (SARGE/MERC) are Fighters at the same radius and head height.
fitting.largeHeroSource: CLAUDE.md frame audit — RAGE 12.47u tall, OLYMPUS 9.44u wide (wings). Collision radius stays 2.2u; the extra width/height is visual silhouette.
fitting.nativeDoorSource: src/engine/citytiles.js door() `DH = 11.2 * M`; bungalow() shell door gap `doorW = 5.8 * M`.

storey.note: Ceiling underside = roofDeckTop - roofSlabThickness = 13.8u (2.59 m): clears the 11u collision head with 2.8u margin and the 12.5u tall-hero silhouette with 1.3u margin.

partition.note: Interior wall across X separating the entry lab (front, +Z) from the case room (rear, -Z).

front_door.note: Standard entrance. Clears fighter body diameter 4.4u and 11u head. Breakable leaf (see breakables.front_door_leaf); the leaf never fills the collider opening — no closed box across the door.

interior_door.note: Aligned with the front door on x=-6 so the soldier recover route is a straight shot front->entry->case.

breach_panel.note: The +X flank weak panel. Intact: filled by a breakable weak panel (blocks, marked with hazard stripes). Breached: a 12u x 13u hole clearing a large hero (9.5u wide, 12.5u tall).

roof_hatch.note: Permanent opening at the stair head; step out onto the deck.

stair.note: Straight flight in the case room's +X bay, floor to roofDeckTop (7 x 2.143u rise = 15.0u). tread and riser derived by the generator; riser <= native step-on snap tolerance 2.5u (src/engine/entity.js:2090 `it.top - 2.5`).

casePedestal.note: Low plinth in the rear case room where the FrontlineEncounter research case is staged. The case object itself is a runtime entity; this recipe supplies the plinth and the case_spawn waypoint.

front_door_leaf.note: The swinging leaf. Opening stays passable in every state; only the leaf mesh is removed on break.

breach_panel.note: The flank weak wall. A superhero breaches it; ordinary structural walls (hp 1200) cannot be shot through.

roof_weak_panel.note: A selected roof (floor-from-above) panel over the case room. A heavy hero smashes down through it into the case room; bounded debris, never whole-building collapse.

roofWeakPanel.note: Location of the breakable roof panel (a 'selected floor piece') over the case room. 10x10u clears a large hero drop. Clear of the hatch and parapet.

structural.note: Desert sand render, load-bearing. Effectively unbreachable by fire; only scripted demolition removes it. This is what makes 'cannot shoot through intact walls' true.

weak_panel.note: Marked weak panel; hazard stripes read as 'hit here'.

door_frame.note: Gold accent frame around the entrance (Impact bible: gold identifies deliberate readable things).

floor_slab.note: Thin ground slab, cosmetic; the standable floor is terrain at y=0.

hazard_stripe.note: Danger-red 'hit here' marking on breakable panels (Impact bible: coral is danger). Decor; hides with its break group.

case_glow.note: Cyan energy marker on the case plinth (Impact bible: cyan is energy).
